support.metric: mean visible defender clearance from carrier-to-target corridor in paired attacking snapshots, metres

shape.metric: RMS distance of offball nonpressing midfield-return targets from authored formation block, metres

difficulty.metric: actual-engine isolated presser approach seconds from 20 m to 2 m, stages 2/5/12/30
difficulty.target: easy >= normal * 1.08 and normal >= hard * 1.04, no RNG read by quality planner

eleven.metric: actual engine counts, identity, unique roles and finite positions after 60 seconds
eleven.target: 22 actors, 11/team, one keeper/team, saved four-card schema unchanged, 0 nonfinite

limits: Support and return metrics are tactical fixture probes, not match win rates; paired full bot matches are recorded separately without treating small samples as balance certification.
